exact: cytoplasmic pattern recognition receptor signalling pathway
cytosolic pattern recognition receptor signaling pathway
narrow: cytoplasmic caspase-recruiting domain (CARD) helicase signaling pathway

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of a ligand from another organism to a cytoplasmic pattern recognition receptor (PRR). PRRs bind pathogen-associated molecular pattern (PAMPs), structures conserved among microbial species.
label: Alpha-protein kinase 1 signaling pathway
